label: Manage Blueprint Permissions
mcp_tool_description: List, grant, or revoke a group's DEPLOY (default) or MANAGE permission on a blueprint, the same rows the blueprint's Permissions tab manages. grant_action list returns anyGroupCanDeploy and the groups that can deploy and manage, for every group (fetch_orderable_groups shows only the caller's). Use list before syncing a blueprint from a Source Control Repository and grant the same groups back afterwards: the importer keeps only the groups named in the metadata and repo exports name none, so a sync of a blueprint whose any_group_can_deploy is false removes every group's permission. Revoke what you granted when a test is over. grant_action open turns the blueprint's Any group can deploy checkbox on, so every group may order it whatever the DEPLOY rows say; restrict turns it off, leaving only the groups with DEPLOY (pass grant_group to grant one in the same call; it refuses when no group would be left). Give the blueprint's global id (BP-...) or exact name and, for grant, revoke and restrict, the group's global id (GRP-...) or exact name. Idempotent. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
